title: A file manager does not open .acre files in acre-gui
body: `acre-gui` has app menu entries in `~/.local/share/applications`. No MIME type covers `.acre` files, so a file manager does not offer `acre-gui` for them. A fix needs a shared-mime-info XML file that maps `*.acre` to a type such as `text/x-acre`, and a `MimeType=` line on both desktop entries.
